scope: Design JSON, source catalogue preservation, parameter arithmetic, inherited primary/skill phase sums at three speed factors, explicit edge-case declarations, status labels and local document links only. No UE runtime, collision, input, animation, hand feel or game balance verification.
review_notes: Uncommitted equipment pickup can cancel into a valid dodge; Q weapon switching cannot.
Each actual projectile emission uses its current source position and height.
Interrupted dodge loses remaining dodge protection without refreshing independent hurt protection or cooldown.
Primary buffering is limited to final primary recovery and invalid buffered requests are cleared.
Airborne-start attacks never qualify for ground-start armor traits; dodge clears named movement and stationary effects.
